signal: The cloud-paper-runner.yml writer-parity loop checked six paths but omitted seven imported first-party executable modules.
root_cause: A manually curated parity allowlist omitted Phase 2 direct and transitive dependencies. The pre-execution hash check could not detect drift in those modules.
comparison_scope: GitHub connector read of both branches on 2026-10-24. The omission was confirmed; no actual module drift or malicious edit was observed.
impact: Unreviewed code could pass the six-path parity gate and run in the cloud PAPER child, compromising safety/provenance. No cloud execution or order incident is asserted.
hypothesis: Extend the pre-execution fail-closed hash comparison to all directly/transitively imported first-party Phase 2 writer modules, and guard the allowlist with an offline regression.
